question: How does a person become liberated from all bonds present in personhood?
premises: All bonds, whether stated or unstated, are characterized as taught in another scripture.
All these bonds are present in the person.
By purifying those bonds there, one is liberated from becoming.
inference: Liberation from worldly becoming comes through purifying all bonds present in the person.
uncertainties: The method of purification is not described in this verse.
plain_english: All the bonds, whether stated or unstated, as characterized in other teachings, are present in the person. By purifying them there, one is liberated from worldly becoming.
